imageGenEnabledDesc: When asking students for photos or selfies in chat, they will generate and send situational photos.
falDesc: Ultra Fast & High Quality (Fal.ai Flux Schnell)
imageGenKeySecurityReassurance: API key is stored locally in your browser (localStorage) and never transmitted to external servers.
imageGenBetaNotice: This feature is in beta (testing). Generation may be slow, fail, or produce unexpected images. It uses external image services, so it is turned off by default.
stabilityCreditPurchase: Buy credits on the Stability AI dashboard
photoLoadError: The image could not be loaded (network error or provider restriction).
errServerBusy: (The line is temporarily busy. Please wait a little, or switch to "{model}" in Settings and try again.)
errRateLimit: (You have hit the short-term message limit (rate limit). Wait 10–20 seconds before sending, or try "{model}" in Settings.)
errAuthFailed: (API key authentication failed. Please check that your API key is entered correctly in Settings (the gear icon at the top right).)
errRetryLater: Please try again after a while
stabilityNoCredit: Your Stability AI credit balance is insufficient (about $0.009 / 0.9 credits per generation). Add credits on the Stability AI dashboard (https://platform.stability.ai/account/credits) or use another image provider.
stabilityInvalidKey: The Stability AI API key is invalid. Please check your API key.
stabilityRateLimit: The Stability AI request limit (rate limit) was reached. Please wait a while and try again.
stabilityKeyMissing: No API key has been entered.
stabilityConnectOk: Connected to Stability AI! Balance: {credits} credits
stabilityConnectLow: Connected to Stability AI, but the balance is insufficient (balance: {credits} credits / required: about 0.9 credits). Please add credits.
photoSendFailed: (📷 {name}: Sending or receiving the photo failed. The camera or the connection seems to be acting up.)
groqUsageExpired: Recovery time has passed. The next response will update this.
groqUsageEmpty: Not available yet. Updated after a chat response; connections without readable rate-limit headers cannot show this.
groqUsageScope: Organization-wide quota for the last response model. Check Groq Console for cumulative and daily usage.
errRateLimitWait: (The AI usage limit has been reached, so replies are unavailable for now. It resumes in about {time}.)
rateLimitPopupBody: The usage limit has been reached, so replies can't be generated. Resumes in: {time}
rateLimitPopupShared: This limit is shared by everyone using the same Groq organization, so other users are affected too.
rateLimitPopupResumed: It's time to resume. Please send your message again.
